$comment: Contract of the SettingsPage and IssueBoardPage screens. Each screen is composed from components only and keeps its own pieces: SettingsSection and SettingsRow on SettingsPage, BoardColumn and IssueCard on IssueBoardPage. Figma owns the anatomy, Storybook the behaviour.

blocks.name: SettingsPage
a11y: One main landmark; each SettingsSection is a section named by its h2 title
Each row's control is named by the row's title
On a phone the switch rows stack, so the control never leaves its label

blocks.name: IssueBoardPage
a11y: One main landmark; each BoardColumn is a section named by its title and count
Each IssueCard is one link named by its title
The lanes scroll sideways when they do not fit, without hiding a lane
